text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there is no need to worry. 'Tis 
merely a trifling injury.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Slap some spit on it and it'll heal right 
up! Ptooey, ptooey!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I really am quite fine. You know how 
resilient I am, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess does not take a break over 
something so minor! Please, let me resume 
training!
choice_data_list:
A princess shouldn't overexert herself, 
for the sake of those around her.

A princess shouldn't push herself too 
hard, for everyone's sake.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For others' sake...? Come to think of it, 
there was a scene just like that in the 
original "Precure" as well...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If a princess pushes herself while running 
a fever, everyone in the castle rushes in 
to help, causing utter chaos!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If... if I were to trouble everyone like 
that, I couldn't bear it...!
choice_data_list:
Then let's make sure to get some proper 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, there's no helping it, is there...? 
I'm just a completely useless princess...

Looking thoroughly dejected, Kawakami 
Princess quietly spent her time resting.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! As you can see, I'm 
completely back on my feet, so you don't 
have to worry one bit, okay?!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Wait! Guuughh!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fugugugu! A-As a princess, I must...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Restraint is important as well, isn't 
it... ngh. *collapse*...!"

It seems the injury has worsened. I 
decided to have her take a break from 
training for a while.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: See? Super sharp, right?
choice_data_list: Looks like you really are fine!
Looks like you really are fine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ This is the true tenacity of a 
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Something of this level cannot stop my 
runaway charge! Now, let us proceed!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We've got to take back every single bit of 
time we lost, properly and thoroughly!

Kawakami Princess made a magnificent 
return to training.
